title: Nutrient Agar

references.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

purpose: A basic general-purpose medium supporting growth of a broad range of non-fastidious heterotrophic bacteria for routine cultivation, maintenance, and teaching use.

formulations.sourceLabel: Typical commercial formulation (e.g. Difco/BBL Nutrient Agar)

reference.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media
Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

preparationSummary: Suspend the dehydrated powder in distilled/deionized water per the manufacturer's stated concentration, heat with agitation to fully dissolve, then sterilize before pouring plates or dispensing into tubes.

sterilization.value: commonly autoclaved at 121°C for 15 minutes for typical batch volumes
sterilization.dependsOn: batch volume, container, and autoclave validation — not a universal setting for every load

reference.label: Difco & BBL Manual of Microbiological Culture Media

storage: Store prepared plates/tubes refrigerated (commonly 2–8°C) in sealed bags to reduce dehydration, away from light.

shelfLife.value: manufacturer-stated shelf life varies by product and storage condition

expectedAppearance: Pale amber/straw-colored, clear to slightly opalescent gel when properly prepared.
qualityControl: Confirm sterility (no growth on an uninoculated control plate) and check that known reference organisms grow as expected before use in critical work.
manufacturerNotes: Exact composition, pH, and shelf life vary by manufacturer and product line — always confirm against the specific product insert in use.
